Subject: Vendor onboarding: VAT docs and PO timing

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the call earlier. We're ready to complete Redwood's vendor onboarding so you can issue a PO and start the Q4 pilot. To avoid delays on our side, could you confirm which of the following pieces of evidence are required for a German GmbH?

- VAT registration certificate (USt-IdNr)
- Company registration (Handelsregister excerpt)
- Completed vendor onboarding form (your portal)
- Bank details (IBAN + BIC)

We can attach the documents but wanted to validate expected formats and whether Redwood needs notarized copies or translated documents. Also, what's a realistic timeline to receive a PO after we submit everything?

Best,
Stefan Kruger
Head of Procurement
LuminaTech GmbH
[attachment: VAT_registration_DE_879412.pdf (pdf)]
From: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: VAT docs and PO timing

Hi Stefan — great to meet you on the call. Short answers up front:

- VAT certificate (USt-IdNr): required. PDF is fine; we accept German-language original.
- Handelsregister excerpt: helpful but not mandatory for PO activation.
- Completed vendor onboarding form: required (we'll send the portal link).
- Bank details: required; please redact the full account number in the email and use the secure upload link we provide.

Timeline: once we receive the required docs and the onboarding form, finance typically completes validation within 2 business days. PO issuance target: within 3–5 business days of validation, assuming no open KYC flags. If finance needs additional validation (beneficial owners, tax rep), this can add a few days.

I'll loop in Marissa from Commercial to confirm contracting terms and Vivek from Finance for the PO queue.

Thanks — I'll attach the portal link in a follow-up and mark this as high priority.

--
Sean Gallagher
Head of Sales, EU
Redwood Inference
